m_e2093a8bacd9139d.text: Badilisha SOP kuwa mtiririko wa kazi. Wape wajibu. Wimbo umekamilika.

m_b6ae66a92d9da6f5.source: Your business runs. You stay in control.
m_b6ae66a92d9da6f5.text: Biashara yako inaendeshwa. Wewe kukaa katika udhibiti.

m_32ddc5d11404fb73.source: UCXO.AI is AI-powered business execution. Turn SOPs into workflows. Assign responsibility. Track completion. Your business runs. You stay in control.
m_32ddc5d11404fb73.text: UCXO.AI ni utekelezaji wa biashara unaoendeshwa na AI. Badilisha SOP kuwa mtiririko wa kazi. Wape wajibu. Wimbo umekamilika. Biashara yako inaendeshwa. Wewe kukaa katika udhibiti.

m_81e624a963d788fe.text: Muhtasari wa nafasi yako ya kazi

m_f7d9663cb8f2bdfd.source: UDashview. Your starting point. See your company, choose a department, and open the module you need.
m_f7d9663cb8f2bdfd.text: UDashview. Sehemu yako ya kuanzia. Angalia kampuni yako, chagua idara, na ufungue moduli unayohitaji.

m_9872f53816742190.source: Use Overview for a quick view, or Activity to follow updates. The view controls offer a map, cards, board, and list.
m_9872f53816742190.text: Tumia Muhtasari kwa mwonekano wa haraka, au Shughuli ili kufuata masasisho. Vidhibiti vya kutazama vinatoa ramani, kadi, ubao na orodha.

m_39059103cf7000a6.source: U&Me. Your tasks and approvals. UDO shows work assigned to you.
m_39059103cf7000a6.text: U&Me. Kazi na idhini zako. UDO inaonyesha kazi uliyokabidhiwa.

m_70b412400b68a6d5.source: Filter by status, search for a task, or check work you assigned to someone else.
m_70b412400b68a6d5.text: Chuja kulingana na hali, tafuta kazi, au angalia kazi uliyokabidhi kwa mtu mwingine.

m_b32cdbd45dc486a6.source: Open UApprove to review requests waiting for your decision. Approve, return, or reject the work.
m_b32cdbd45dc486a6.text: Fungua UApprove ili ukague maombi yanayosubiri uamuzi wako. Idhinisha, rudisha au ukatae kazi hiyo.

m_b58e60e663610a0d.source: USpace. Where you do the work. Fill published forms in UForms and track your submissions.
m_b58e60e663610a0d.text: USpace. Ambapo unafanya kazi. Jaza fomu zilizochapishwa katika UForms na ufuatilie mawasilisho yako.

m_192afa8e52114980.source: URecords stores documents and evidence, with their revision and approval details.
m_192afa8e52114980.text: URecords huhifadhi hati na ushahidi, pamoja na masahihisho na maelezo yake ya idhini.

m_6a2514332154df32.source: U-Engine shows workflow runs, progress, and exceptions. This sample has no runs yet.
m_6a2514332154df32.text: U-Engine inaonyesha utendakazi, maendeleo na vighairi. Sampuli hii bado haijatekelezwa.

m_c81c4c362358a4ca.source: UTraining brings together assigned lessons, due dates, and assessments.
m_c81c4c362358a4ca.text: UTraining huleta pamoja masomo uliyokabidhiwa, tarehe za kukamilisha na tathmini.

m_9716058584d2e875.source: UMaster. Set up how your business works. Start with Mission and Objectives to define the goal and its owner.
m_9716058584d2e875.text: UMaster. Weka jinsi biashara yako inavyofanya kazi. Anza na Misheni na Malengo ili kufafanua lengo na mmiliki wake.

m_2dbfb98897c60187.source: Work Planner schedules jobs with the people and equipment they need.
m_2dbfb98897c60187.text: Mpangaji Kazi hupanga kazi na watu na vifaa wanavyohitaji.

m_22f782c1fb4bee67.source: Engine Planner defines the workflow. Test it, get approval, and activate it before execution.
m_22f782c1fb4bee67.text: Engine Planner inafafanua mtiririko wa kazi. Ijaribu, pata idhini, na uiwashe kabla ya utekelezaji.

m_0b49698a58558f6c.source: HR Master manages roles, skills, and staff availability.
m_0b49698a58558f6c.text: HR Master inasimamia majukumu, ujuzi, na upatikanaji wa wafanyakazi.

m_90a6597976c747d6.source: Machine Master manages equipment capacity, availability, and maintenance.
m_90a6597976c747d6.text: Machine Master inasimamia uwezo wa vifaa, upatikanaji, na matengenezo.

m_fd5dc6d6e52fcaca.source: Forms Master creates and publishes the templates your team fills in UForms.
m_fd5dc6d6e52fcaca.text: Forms Master huunda na kuchapisha violezo ambavyo timu yako hujaza UForms.

m_09e3587cb68a3c69.source: Delegation Master defines who can take over a task or approval, and for how long.
m_09e3587cb68a3c69.text: Mwalimu Mkuu wa Uteuzi hufafanua ni nani anayeweza kuchukua jukumu au idhini, na kwa muda gani.

m_df47342c9168e615.source: Explore the conversation overview, inbox, shared tasks, channels, people, and workspace settings.
m_df47342c9168e615.text: Kagua muhtasari wa mazungumzo, kisanduku pokezi, kazi zilizoshirikiwa, vituo, watu na mipangilio ya nafasi ya kazi.

m_d490fd6fcb8b2524.source: UPingme has its own conversation overview. It brings together unread mentions, unread conversations, open tasks from conversations, and unsubmitted proposals, with links back to the relevant work.
m_d490fd6fcb8b2524.text: UPingme ina muhtasari wa mazungumzo yake. Huleta pamoja kutaja ambazo hazijasomwa, mazungumzo ambayo hayajasomwa, kazi wazi kutoka kwa mazungumzo, na mapendekezo ambayo hayajawasilishwa, na viungo vya kurudi kwa kazi husika.

m_eab1443955952c78.source: Select Inbox to find conversations you belong to. Filters separate unread conversations, direct messages, mentions, and activity. The sample shows the ops-planning team channel and its unread conversation.
m_eab1443955952c78.text: Chagua Kikasha ili kupata mazungumzo unayoshiriki. Vichujio hutenganisha mazungumzo ambayo hayajasomwa, ujumbe wa moja kwa moja, mtaji na shughuli. Sampuli inaonyesha idhaa ya timu ya mipango ya ops na mazungumzo yake ambayo hayajasomwa.

m_d36dc680c501fc22.source: Select UDO to see the same task store used by UCXO. Conversation tasks link back to their source. A message proposal becomes a task only after it is reviewed and submitted.
m_d36dc680c501fc22.text: Chagua UDO ili kuona hifadhi sawa ya kazi inayotumiwa na UCXO. Majukumu ya mazungumzo yanaunganishwa kurudi kwenye chanzo chao. Pendekezo la ujumbe huwa kazi tu baada ya kukaguliwa na kuwasilishwa.

m_8a2c62b49510e40b.source: Select Team channels to see your channels, open channels you can join, and archived channels. Private channels are visible only to members. The sample separates ops-planning from company-wide plant announcements.
m_8a2c62b49510e40b.text: Chagua chaneli za Timu ili kuona vituo vyako, kufungua vituo unavyoweza kujiunga na vituo vilivyohifadhiwa kwenye kumbukumbu. Vituo vya faragha vinaonekana kwa wanachama pekee. Sampuli hutenganisha upangaji mipango kutoka kwa matangazo ya kampuni nzima.

m_1386ced0f979943d.source: Select Work conversations to keep a discussion bound to an objective, plan, task, form, record, or work item. Its status and version still come from the object’s own module.
m_1386ced0f979943d.text: Chagua Mazungumzo ya kazi ili kuweka majadiliano yakiambatana na lengo, mpango, kazi, fomu, rekodi, au kipengele cha kazi. Hali yake na toleo bado hutoka kwa moduli ya kitu yenyewe.

m_bde9e41bee8d1e6a.text: Simu na mikutano · Hali ya sasa

m_177cbc5df53b0c0e.source: Calls and meetings is visible in the navigation, but the supplied build has no calling provider. This screen explains that calls, scheduling, recording, and transcripts are not currently available.
m_177cbc5df53b0c0e.text: Simu na mikutano inaonekana katika urambazaji, lakini muundo uliotolewa hauna mtoaji wa simu. Skrini hii inaeleza kuwa simu, kuratibu, kurekodi na manukuu hazipatikani kwa sasa.

m_3e3b809863c1745c.source: Select People directory to find colleagues you can message, with teams and roles from UUsers. Active account status is shown; the reference does not provide real-time presence.
m_3e3b809863c1745c.text: Chagua saraka ya Watu ili kupata wenzako unaoweza kuwatumia ujumbe, na timu na majukumu kutoka kwa UUsers. Hali ya akaunti inayotumika inaonyeshwa; rejeleo haitoi uwepo wa wakati halisi.

m_79456d085a460f84.source: Select Workspace settings for channel topics, membership, reading and posting permissions, and policy history. The sample user has read-only access. Messages coordinate work; they do not approve or complete it.
m_79456d085a460f84.text: Chagua mipangilio ya Nafasi ya Kazi kwa mada za kituo, uanachama, ruhusa za kusoma na kuchapisha na historia ya sera. Mtumiaji wa sampuli ana ufikiaji wa kusoma tu. Ujumbe kuratibu kazi; hawaidhinishi wala kuikamilisha.

m_a4b475dfb31195c2.source: Tap the screen to inspect it at full size.
m_a4b475dfb31195c2.text: Gonga skrini ili kuikagua kwa ukubwa kamili.

m_eac84a149bcbf84b.text: Mtu anayewajibika hupokea na kukamilisha kazi ya kurejesha iliyokabidhiwa katika UDO.
